import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(mu, sigma, sample_size):
    if isinstance(sample_size, bool) or not np.isscalar(sample_size):
        raise TypeError("sample_size must be a non-negative integer")
    if isinstance(sample_size, float):
        if not sample_size.is_integer():
            raise TypeError("sample_size must be a non-negative integer")
        sample_size = int(sample_size)
    elif isinstance(sample_size, (np.integer, int)):
        sample_size = int(sample_size)
    else:
        raise TypeError("sample_size must be a non-negative integer")

    if sample_size < 0:
        raise ValueError("sample_size must be non-negative")

    samples = np.random.normal(mu, sigma, sample_size)

    plt.hist(samples, bins=30, alpha=0.75, color="blue")
    plt.xlabel("Sample values")
    plt.ylabel("Frequency")
    plt.title("Histogram of Generated Samples")
    plt.show()

    return samples
